items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: It's called Singing Rimbled, Pasigula. They claim, what he used the term, singing river, is they're doing the slaves.

ctx.x: That music, you would have that, too. You would have that, because... You're like, you had a phrase out once that... You'd go on it easy. That much. Wait a while, Jim. Let me tell you about the place they call, right up here in Mississippi, where it got that big shipyard. It's called Singing Rimbled, Pasigula. They claim, what he used the term, singing river, is they're doing the slaves. The lots of slaves come in the side, drown themselves. Nowadays, I don't know if that's true or not. They claim they all walked…

See, this is one thing. That number, just the Crow Walker did. That's why I tell a lot. I don't play with Billy Dee Dee Band. Because no one don't sing it. People, you want you to hear them. You want you to hear the voice. Yeah. You want you to hear the voice. I don't want to hear the voice. I don't want to hear the voice.
